tripExperiences.name: Sand Dollar Beach
tripExperiences.notes: Sweeping black sand beach on the southern Big Sur coast. First real stop on the drive north.

tripExperiences.name: McWay Falls
tripExperiences.notes: 80-foot waterfall dropping straight onto the beach. Short walk, massive payoff.

tripExperiences.name: Bixby Bridge Viewpoint
tripExperiences.notes: The iconic arched bridge over the canyon. Stop on both sides.

tripExperiences.name: Point Lobos
tripExperiences.notes: Coastal bluffs with sea views. Overlaps with Carmel territory — worth the slight detour.

tripExperiences.name: Garrapata State Beach & Lily Valley
tripExperiences.notes: Sunset here. Wedding photoshoot in progress, dog climbing rocks, everyone quiet. One of those moments.

tripExperiences.name: Casa De Fruta
tripExperiences.notes: Roadside market on the way in. Fresh fruit, dried goods, wine, a carousel, and a train ride. Surprisingly fun stop.

tripExperiences.name: Tunnel View
tripExperiences.notes: El Capitan and Half Dome framed by the tunnel entrance. Hit it at golden hour on the sunset drive back.

tripExperiences.name: Bridalveil Fall
tripExperiences.notes: Quick walk to one of Yosemite's most photogenic falls.

tripExperiences.name: El Capitan Meadow
tripExperiences.notes: Standing in the meadow staring straight up at 3,000 feet of granite. Nothing prepares you for how big it actually is.

tripExperiences.name: Mist Trail to Vernal Falls
tripExperiences.notes: Made it to Vernal Falls. Loop trail was closed — had to backtrack the same steep path down. Still completely worth it.

tripExperiences.name: St Helena Wine Passport
tripExperiences.notes: $95/person. Four vineyards in one afternoon. The kind of day that sneaks up on you.
